newsitem.title: EU: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ C 351 OF NOVEMBER 22, 1996.
newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ C 351 OF NOVEMBER 22, 1996.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)

Phare - supply of telematic equipment and software within the framework of extending the telematic network of the European Environment Agency (EIONET telematics) to Phare partner countries Notice of invitation to tender issued by the European Commission (96/C 351/11)
Monitoring (by remote detection) of aids for cultivated areas or areas under forage Open procedure (96/C 351/10)
Study on the opening up of the Leonardo da Vinci Programme to Baltic countries and Slovenia Contract award notice relating to public services contract No DG XXII/07/96 (96/C 351/09)
Tacis - computer and office equipment Notice of invitation to tender issued by the Commission of the European Communities financed in the framework of the Tacis programme (96/C 351/07)
Non-opposition to a notified concentration (Case No IV/M.829 - Thyssen/Bohler-Uddeholm) (96/C 351/06)
Prior notification of a concentration (Case No IV/M.802 - Telecom Eireann) (96/C 351/05)
Notice regarding applications for reimbursement of import duty paid on durum wheat imported from 1 January 1996 under Regulation (EC) No 2228/96 (96/C 351/04)

Notice of initiation of an examination procedure concerning an obstacle to trade, within the meaning of Council Regulation (EC) No 3286/94, consisting of changes made by the United States of America (USA) in their rules of origin for textile and apparel products (96/C 351/03)
Authorization for State aid pursuant to Articles 92 and 93 of the EC Treaty Cases where the Commission raises no objections (96/C 351/02)
